summary: Tanya KN F4/F5 full regression (backend + frontend). Backend: 13/13 pytest pass across tests/test_tanya_kn_f4_f5.py (7) + tests/test_tanya_kn_f2_f3.py (6). Eval harness `tools/ai_eval/run_eval.py --mode engine` reports {n:110, p50_ms:5, args_valid_pct:100.0, access_denied_pct:100.0}. Frontend (admin, /?view=tanya-kn&entity=ent_ksc, desktop 1920x1080): sidebar tabs tanya-tab-reports|history|schedules all present; header pill 'Menunggu kunci OpenAI' + budget '$0.00 / $100' visible. Template run [tanya-template-top_customers] → [tanya-narrative] with [tanya-narrative-source]='Ringkasan otomatis dari angka server' and body contains 'Rp' (Rp 83.625.000 …); second run within cache window shows kicker '· DARI CACHE' in PENJUALAN pill. Feedback: [tanya-feedback-up] click OK; [tanya-feedback-down] opens [tanya-feedback-comment-box] with [tanya-feedback-comment] + [tanya-feedback-submit], submitted successfully. Schedule from template answer: [tanya-answer-schedule] → [tanya-schedule-dialog] with all fields (title, freq daily/weekly, time, save) → switches to Jadwal tab → row [tanya-schedule-aisch_…] with [tanya-schedule-active-<id>] switch and [tanya-schedule-run-<id>] which opens full report (narrative present) and adds run under 'Kiriman terakhir' [tanya-run-<runId>]; delete flow removes row. Chat disabled (default): free question 'bagaimana tren diskon kuartal ini' → [tanya-thread-question] + [tanya-suggestions] (with notice). Exact template prompt 'Siapa 10 pelanggan dengan pembelian terbesar bulan ini?' → [tanya-answer] + [tanya-chat-text] saying 'Pertanyaan ini cocok dengan template “Pelanggan terbesar”, jadi dijawab langsung tanpa AI…', plus 3 [tanya-followup-] chips (WITHOUT AI). Mock mode enabled via PUT /api/config/values (ai.enabled=true, ai.model_main=mock-chat) → status pill switches to 'Mode uji (tiruan)'. Asked 2 questions in a row in same session — after Q2 [tanya-thread-question] count=2 and each has [tanya-answer]; save flow works: [tanya-answer-save-template] → [tanya-save-template-dialog] with title/submit; created template appears in Reports tab under [tanya-my-templates] as [tanya-my-template-<id>] and [tanya-my-template-delete-<id>] removes it. History: [tanya-history] + [tanya-history-search] filters (search 'ranking' narrowed 16 → 1 session); [tanya-session-open-<id>] reopens thread; [tanya-new-chat] clears; [tanya-session-delete-<id>] + [tanya-session-confirm-delete-<id>] two-step delete works. Config restored at end: ai.enabled=false, ai.model_main='gpt-6-sol' (verified via /api/ai/status).
critical_code_review_comments: Cache kicker text renders as '· DARI CACHE' inside the PENJUALAN pill (uppercase due to CSS text-transform); spec wording was '· dari cache'. Cosmetic only — the semantic testid still surfaces the cache state.

Save-template dialog only appears on chat answers (mock/real AI). Not shown on template-answer view (correct, since templates ARE templates), but there is no indicator to users that the option only exists for AI-generated answers.
History list can grow unbounded — 16 sessions found during iter75; consider pagination or an ai.chat_retention_days sweeper hook on the client to reduce scroll fatigue (server retention key exists).
